# Media fixtures

One small file per format row of the media plan, generated by `scripts/media-fixtures.sh` from ffmpeg's own test sources
(`testsrc2` 320x180 at 25 fps, `sine` 440 Hz at 48 kHz stereo). Nothing third-party. Each file is at most 2 s and 300 KB.

`manifest.tsv` has 26 rows: `file kind codec expect sha256 ref`.

| expect | What `tests/fixtures_decode.rs` proves |
| --- | --- |
| `play` | the helper opens it and the first 3 pictures match ffmpeg's decode (PSNR >= 45 dB on luma), or the first second of audio matches (lossless: s16 PCM hash equal; lossy: RMS within 1 %) |
| `refuse` | the helper answers `NoDecoder` or `Unsupported`, never a picture or PCM (interlaced and 10-bit H.264, MPEG-4 Part 2, WMV2, WMA) |
| `reduced` | it plays and says `reduced_quality` (HE-AAC at its LC core) |

HEVC rows are `play` in the manifest. Through the shipped route table HEVC is on the system decoder, so the two HEVC cases
expect `NoSystemDecoder(Hevc)`; `fixture_hevc_main_rust_route` and `fixture_hevc_main10_rust_route` route HEVC to FilmCraft
in a test table and prove its decoder.

`ref/<stem>.y` holds the Y planes of the first 3 frames as ffmpeg decodes them; the manifest's `ref` is their SHA-256.

## Regenerate

Needs ffmpeg with libx264, libx265, libvpx, libaom-av1 or libsvtav1, libfdk_aac, libmp3lame, libopus, libvorbis:

    scripts/media-fixtures.sh

It downloads nothing; without ffmpeg it exits 2 with "ffmpeg missing". Then run
`cargo test --locked --release --test fixtures_decode` in `native/beebeeb-media-helper`.
